description: This file defines a controller class 'SaveSystemUserController' within the OrangeHRM HRM system, responsible for handling the pre-render logic for saving or editing system users. It uses traits and classes related to Vue components and handles setting properties based on request attributes and social media authentication status.

classes.name: SaveSystemUserController
classes.description: A controller class extending AbstractVueController that manages the pre-render setup for system user save/edit forms, including handling social media authentication status.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, determining which component to display based on whether a user ID exists in the request, and whether social media authentication is enabled.
